MATCH (s:Set)-[:IN_THEME]->(t:Theme)
WHERE s.year = 2013 AND t.name = 'Books'
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:SUBTHEME_OF*0..6]->(parent:Theme)
WITH s, t, parent
MATCH (s)-[:IN_THEME]->(st:Theme)
WHERE st = t OR st = parent
WITH DISTINCT s
MATCH (s)-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(inv:Inventory)
WITH s, inv
ORDER BY inv.version DESC
WITH s, head(collect(inv)) AS current_inv
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (current_inv)-[:CONTAINS_SET|CONTAINS_MINIFIG|HAS_PART*1..6]->(leaf)
WHERE all(r IN rels(path) WHERE NOT (type(r) = 'HAS_PART' AND r.is_spare = true))
WITH s, current_inv, path,
     [r IN rels(path) WHERE type(r) = 'HAS_PART' | r.qty] AS partQtys,
     [r IN rels(path) WHERE type(r) = 'CONTAINS_SET' OR type(r) = 'CONTAINS_MINIFIG' | r.qty] AS containerQtys
WITH s, current_inv, path,
     list_product(containerQtys) AS containerMult,
     partQtys
UNWIND partQtys AS pq
WITH s, current_inv, path, containerMult, pq
RETURN sum(containerMult * pq) AS total_parts
```
